'''Kor Pastar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Rutian/Legends|blue-skinned]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]]. She was the daughter of [[Vel Pastar]], and would find new hires on [[Nirama's public asteroid]] and direct them to talk to her father.
